lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hmm, you've got an accent... where're you from?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Korea. Just landed a couple of weeks ago.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Ah, nice! That's a big move. How're you liking it so far?
lines.ko: 오, 좋다! 큰 결심했네. 지금까지 지내보니 어때?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Loving it so far. People are super chill here.
lines.ko: 지금까진 너무 좋아. 여기 사람들 엄청 여유로워.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: So, where're you living these days?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Melbourne, just near the CBD.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh sweet! That area's pretty walkable, huh?
lines.ko: 오 좋다! 거기 걸어 다니기 좋지?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, love it. Cafes and shops everywhere.
lines.ko: 응, 완전 좋아. 카페랑 가게가 여기저기 다 있어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: So, what do you do? Work or study?
lines.ko: 그래서 무슨 일 해? 일해, 아니면 공부해?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: A bit of both. I'm a barista by day, uni student by night.
lines.ko: 둘 다 조금씩. 낮에는 바리스타, 밤에는 대학생이야.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Wow hustling hard, I like it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Haha, keeps me busy but I'm loving it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: So, how old are you anyway?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: How old do I look?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Maybe 22?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Haha, thanks! I'm 28 actually.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No way! Thought you were my little sister's age.
lines.ko: 말도 안 돼! 내 여동생 나이인 줄 알았어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Haha, I'll take that as a compliment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey! You must be Daniel, right?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, that's me. How's it going?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Pretty good! Finally meeting you in person feels kinda weird in a good way.
lines.ko: 잘 지내! 드디어 직접 만나니까 좋은 의미로 좀 신기하다.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Haha, I know what you mean. You look just like your photos!
lines.ko: 하하, 무슨 말인지 알아. 너 사진이랑 똑같다!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks! You too. Glad we finally met.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: G'day mate! How ya going?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, not too bad. You?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can't complain. Just finished work. Ready for a cold one.
lines.ko: 괜찮아. 방금 일 끝났어. 시원한 맥주 한잔하고 싶다.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Haha, classic. You heading to the pub?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Reckon so. Gotta unwind somehow!
lines.ko: 그럴 것 같아. 어떻게든 좀 쉬어야지!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, I saw your post on Facebook. Is this position still available?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 페이스북에서 올리신 글 봤는데요. 이 자리 아직 구하세요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hey! Yeah, we're still looking for someone. Do you have experience?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! 네, 아직 사람 구하고 있어요. 경력 있으세요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, I worked in a cafe back in Melbourne.
lines.ko: 네, 전에 멜버른에서 카페 일 했었어요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Nice one. You can send me your resume or drop it off tomorrow.
lines.ko: 좋네요. 이력서 보내주시거나 내일 직접 갖다주셔도 돼요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great, I'll bring it in person. Thanks a lot!
lines.ko: 좋아요, 제가 직접 가져갈게요. 정말 감사해요!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No worries, see you then!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm looking for a job. Can I leave my resume?
lines.ko: 일자리 구하고 있는데요. 이력서 두고 가도 될까요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, no worries. What kind of experience do you have?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I've got some experience in hospitality. I worked in a cafe for a year.
lines.ko: 요식업 쪽 경험이 좀 있어요. 카페에서 1년 일했어요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Perfect. When is your availability?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm available on Monday to Friday, from 7am to 6pm.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Awesome, we'll be in touch soon. Thanks for dropping it off!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: So, tell me a bit about yourself.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure! I've been in Australia for about six months. I used to work as a barista back home.
lines.ko: 네! 호주에 온 지 한 6개월 됐어요. 한국에서는 바리스타로 일했었어요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Nice. Do you feel comfortable working in a fast-paced environment?
lines.ko: 좋네요. 바쁘게 돌아가는 환경에서 일하는 거 괜찮아요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, absolutely. I'm a quick learner and I don't mind pressure.
lines.ko: 네, 완전 괜찮아요. 저 빨리 배우는 편이고 압박감도 괜찮아요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good to hear. When can you start?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I can start right away. I live just five minutes away.
lines.ko: 바로 시작할 수 있어요. 여기서 5분 거리에 살아요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks for explaining the job. Can I ask a few questions about the pay?
lines.ko: 일 설명해주셔서 감사해요. 급여에 대해 몇 가지 여쭤봐도 될까요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Of course, go ahead.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How much is the pay rate?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's $28 per hour on weekdays and $32 on weekends.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Nice! Is it cash or bank transfer?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Bank transfer, we pay every Thursday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Great. Do you also pay superannuation?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yep, we do.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Awesome. What's the roster like?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You'll get around 25 to 30 hours a week.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sounds good to me. Thanks for letting me know!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, thanks for having me today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No worries, glad you could make it. Have you brought your RSA?
lines.ko: 별말씀을요, 와줘서 반가워요. RSA(주류 서빙 자격증) 가져왔어요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, I've got it. Should I also bring my apron and uniform?
lines.ko: 네, 가져왔어요. 앞치마랑 유니폼도 가져와야 하나요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, that'd be great. What time can you start?
lines.ko: 네, 그러면 좋죠. 몇 시부터 시작할 수 있어요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm free to start anytime. How long will the trial be?
lines.ko: 언제든 시작할 수 있어요. 트라이얼은 얼마나 해요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just a few hours this morning.
lines.ko: 오늘 오전에 몇 시간만 할 거예요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yep, that'd be perfect. Let's get started!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you please cover my shift on Friday?
lines.ko: 금요일에 내 시프트 좀 대신 해줄 수 있어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah sure all good.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You sure? I owe you one. You're a legend.
lines.ko: 진짜? 내가 신세 한 번 졌다. 너 최고야.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No worries, seriously. Happens all the time.
lines.ko: 진짜 괜찮아. 늘 있는 일인데 뭐.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: By the way what you gonna do on Friday?
lines.ko: 근데 너 금요일에 뭐 할 거야?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm having a barbie with my friends

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's bloody hot today!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Tell me about it! I reckon it's like 40 degrees.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Heaps of people down at the beach, though.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, no wonder. It's way too nice to stay inside.
lines.ko: 응, 그럴 만하지. 안에만 있기엔 날씨가 너무 좋잖아.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, can I grab a magic, takeaway please?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure thing. Anything else for you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah...nah, that's all. Cheers, mate.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No worries. That'll be five fifty

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I heard you got the job!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, I'm pretty stoked, actually!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good on ya! You deserve it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thanks! The interview was a bit rough, though.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Ah yeah, they can be brutal sometimes.
lines.ko: 아 그치, 면접이 가끔 진짜 빡세긴 하지.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, you right, mate? You look knackered.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, just on break. Needed a minute to breathe.
lines.ko: 응, 그냥 쉬는 시간이야. 잠깐 숨 좀 돌려야 해서.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Fair enough. Go get some fresh air, you've earned it.
lines.ko: 그럴 만하지. 바람 좀 쐬고 와, 그럴 자격 있어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Cheers, I'll be back in five minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, can you do me a favor?
lines.ko: 야, 부탁 하나만 들어줄 수 있어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure what's that?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you give me a hand with these plates?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yup, where should I put them?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Just chuck them in the bin, they're cracked.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, how's your day been?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Mate, I'm flat out. It's been hectic since morning.
lines.ko: 야, 나 완전 정신없어. 아침부터 계속 바빴어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Tell me about it. I haven't even had a coffee yet.
lines.ko: 내 말이. 나 아직 커피도 한 잔 못 마셨어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hang in there, almost done.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Before I put your order through, any allergies at all?
lines.ko: 주문 넣기 전에, 혹시 알레르기 있으세요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, I'm allergic to nuts.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks for letting me know.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sorry for being picky, but I try to avoid nuts completely.
lines.ko: 까다롭게 굴어서 죄송한데, 견과류는 아예 안 먹으려고 해요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it. I'll mark it clearly on your order.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: The dish is nut-free, but I'll double-check with the kitchen.
lines.ko: 그 요리는 견과류가 안 들어가는데, 주방에 한 번 더 확인해 볼게요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi! I saw your ad on Flatmates. Is the room still available?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! Flatmates에서 광고 봤어요. 방 아직 있어요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hey! Yep, it's still available.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great. Can I come for an inspection?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. When would be a good time for you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm free tomorrow evening. Does that work?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, that works for me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Nice. By the way, how many people are currently living there?
lines.ko: 좋네요. 그런데 지금 거기 몇 명 살고 있어요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just three of us. All full-time workers.
lines.ko: 저희 세 명뿐이에요. 다 풀타임으로 일해요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect. Is the rent per week or per month?
lines.ko: 완벽하네요. 렌트비는 주 단위예요, 월 단위예요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's $290 per week. Bond is two weeks' rent.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it. And what are the other housemates like?
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 그리고 다른 하우스메이트들은 어떤 사람들이에요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, welcome! You here for the inspection?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 어서 와요! 방 보러 오신 거죠?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yep! Thanks for having me. I'm looking for a long-term stay.
lines.ko: 네! 불러주셔서 고마워요. 저는 오래 지낼 곳을 찾고 있어요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Nice. What do you do?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I work full-time. And I'm tidy and pretty easy-going.
lines.ko: 풀타임으로 일해요. 그리고 깔끔하고 꽤 무난한 성격이에요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Good to know.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: By the way, is the bathroom shared or private?
lines.ko: 그런데 화장실은 같이 써요, 아니면 혼자 써요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It's shared, but only with one other person.
lines.ko: 같이 쓰는데, 딱 한 명이랑만 써요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Got it. And are bills included in the rent?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yep, everything's included. Electricity, water, internet...
lines.ko: 네, 다 포함이에요. 전기, 수도, 인터넷...

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: When is the move-in date?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: From next Monday. You can move in anytime after that.
lines.ko: 다음 주 월요일부터요. 그 이후엔 언제든 들어와도 돼요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great. How long is the minimum stay?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Minimum stay would be three months.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: And the notice period?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's two weeks. Just let us know before you move out.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Cool. Is the bond refundable?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: 100%, as long as there's no damage.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks for showing me around.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No wuckas! Feel free to look around.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you mind if I check the kitchen?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Go for it. You can open the drawers if you like.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Nice. I really like the place. I'll let you know soon!
lines.ko: 좋네요. 여기 정말 마음에 들어요. 곧 연락드릴게요!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Quick question, are there any house rules I should know about?
lines.ko: 하나만 물어볼게요. 제가 알아야 할 집 규칙 같은 거 있어요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Nothing strict. Just clean up after yourself and don't be too loud at night.
lines.ko: 엄격한 건 없어요. 쓴 건 알아서 치우고, 밤에 너무 시끄럽게만 안 하면 돼요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it. Where can I put my food in the fridge and cupboard?
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 냉장고랑 찬장에 제 음식은 어디에 두면 돼요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: The middle shelf is free.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Cool. Also, do we share the cleaning or do we take turns?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 그리고 청소는 같이 해요, 아니면 돌아가면서 해요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We usually take turns.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Perfect. And one more thing, how do we sort the rubbish here?
lines.ko: 완벽하네요. 그리고 하나 더, 여기 쓰레기 분리수거는 어떻게 해요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: General waste goes in the red bin, recycling in the yellow.
lines.ko: 일반 쓰레기는 빨간 통에, 재활용은 노란 통에 넣어요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you mind if I keep my stuff here on this shelf?
lines.ko: 내 물건 이 선반에 둬도 괜찮아?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Well, technically, the shelf is my space.
lines.ko: 음, 사실 그 선반은 내 자리야.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: But I don't have much stuff so you can use it.
lines.ko: 근데 난 짐이 별로 없으니까 너가 써도 돼.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Cheers. By the way, I noticed the sink was full this morning.
lines.ko: 고마워. 그런데 오늘 아침에 보니까 싱크대가 꽉 차 있더라.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, whose turn is it to take out the rubbish? The bin's full.
lines.ko: 야, 쓰레기 버릴 차례 누구야? 쓰레기통 꽉 찼어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I think it's mine, sorry. I'll do it now.
lines.ko: 내 차례인 것 같아, 미안. 지금 할게.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: All good man. Hey, do we have a cleaning roster?
lines.ko: 괜찮아. 근데 우리 청소 당번표 있어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not really, we've just been doing it randomly.
lines.ko: 딱히 없어, 그냥 되는 대로 해왔어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hmm, maybe we could make a cleaning schedule?
lines.ko: 흠, 청소 스케줄 하나 만들어 보는 게 어때?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Nah, I can't be bothered

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Last night the music was a bit loud. Do you mind keeping the noise down a bit after 11?
lines.ko: 어젯밤에 음악이 좀 시끄러웠어. 11시 이후엔 소리 좀 줄여줄 수 있어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, my bad. I'll keep it down.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Thanks! And the bathroom, can we try to keep it tidy?
lines.ko: 고마워! 그리고 화장실 말인데, 좀 깨끗하게 쓰도록 하자?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yep, I'll make sure of it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm asking because I think someone had all of my cookies yesterday.
lines.ko: 물어보는 이유가, 어제 누가 내 쿠키를 다 먹은 것 같아서.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You gotta be kidding me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah, my whole box of cookies was gone. So just a reminder, please don't take my food without asking.
lines.ko: 응, 쿠키 한 상자가 통째로 없어졌어. 그러니까 한 번 더 말하는데, 내 음식은 물어보고 먹어줘.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, fair enough.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Also, I'll be away this weekend, just letting you know in case any mail arrives.
lines.ko: 그리고 나 이번 주말에 없어, 혹시 우편물 오면 알고 있으라고 말하는 거야.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No worries. Is it okay if I have a friend over tonight? Just for dinner.
lines.ko: 알겠어. 오늘 밤에 친구 불러도 돼? 저녁만 먹고 갈 거야.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah, that's fine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, I'd like to open a bank account.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 은행 계좌를 하나 만들고 싶어요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. Are you new to Australia?
lines.ko: 네. 호주에 오신 지 얼마 안 되셨어요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, I've just arrived. I'm on a working holiday visa.
lines.ko: 네, 막 도착했어요. 워킹홀리데이 비자로 왔어요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No worries. Do you have your passport with you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, I'd like to check my balance.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. Please enter your PIN number.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'd like to deposit this cash.

lines.en: Hi, I'd like to join the gym. How much is the membership?

lines.en: So it's $22.50 per week, right?

lines.en: Exactly!

lines.en: Do you also offer a free trial?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is there any promo going on at the moment?

lines.en: Yes, there is. It's usually $45 per week, but for the first 12 weeks, it's $22.50 per week.
lines.ko: 네, 있어요. 원래 주당 45달러인데, 처음 12주 동안은 주당 22.50달러예요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yep, exactly.

lines.ko: 아니요, 그냥 친구한테 추천 링크만 보내주면 돼요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Bella's Italian, good evening.

lines.en: Hi, I'd like to make a reservation for four at 7:30.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Indoor or outdoor seating?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Indoors, please. Would it be possible to get a window seat?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Should be alright. Can I get a name and contact number?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. It's Nathan. 0452 461 660.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Lovely, I'll see you at 7:30.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi! What can I get for you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hi, I'll just grab one of those banana breads.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 저 바나나 브레드 하나 주세요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sure. Anything else?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: And I'll do a strong cap. I was just wondering if you have any sweetener.
lines.ko: 그리고 카푸치노 진하게 하나요. 혹시 감미료 있어요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, we do. We've got Equal and Stevia.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Great, I'll have Equal in my coffee. And the banana bread plain, toasted, with extra butter, please.
lines.ko: 좋아요, 커피에 이퀄 넣어 주세요. 그리고 바나나 브레드는 아무것도 안 올리고 토스트해서 버터 추가로 주세요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No worries. That'll be $10.80. When you're ready.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Here you go. One tiramisu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, sorry, I don't think we ordered this.
lines.ko: 어, 죄송한데 저희 이거 안 시킨 것 같아요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's right. This one's on the house.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah, sorry about the wait earlier. We wanted to make it up to you.
lines.ko: 네, 아까 오래 기다리게 해서 죄송해요. 보답하고 싶었어요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh wow, thanks. We appreciate it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No worries. Enjoy!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How does it feel?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It fits like a glove, but a little snug around the toes.
lines.ko: 딱 맞는데, 발가락 쪽이 좀 꽉 껴요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You might want to go half a size up, because Salomon runs small, you know?
lines.ko: 반 사이즈 올리시는 게 나을 수도 있어요, 살로몬이 좀 작게 나오거든요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, could I try an eight and a half?
lines.ko: 네, 8.5 사이즈 신어 볼 수 있을까요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Big summer blowout! How can I help?
lines.ko: 여름 대박 세일 중이에요! 뭐 도와드릴까요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm just browsing. I'll let you know if I need any help.
lines.ko: 그냥 구경 중이에요. 도움 필요하면 말씀드릴게요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh, those are on special. Buy one, get one free.
lines.ko: 아, 그거 세일 중이에요. 하나 사면 하나 공짜예요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Do you have this in a larger size?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes. Would you like to try it on?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Is there a fitting room?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How do you like it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's a bit tight around the shoulders. I'll come back later.
lines.ko: 어깨 쪽이 좀 껴요. 나중에 다시 올게요.

lines.en: Excuse me, does this tram go to Melbourne Central?
lines.ko: 실례지만, 이 트램 멜번 센트럴 가요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is that in the free tram zone?

lines.en: Sweet!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Maybe we've got an issue with the machine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you do that manually?

lines.en: Sure, how much would you like to top up?

lines.en: I'll top up $30.

lines.en: Even better! Thank you for your help.

lines.en: Excuse me, how do I get to this cafe?

lines.en: Oh, it's just down the road.
lines.ko: 아, 이 길 따라 조금만 가면 있어요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is it far from here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not at all. About a 5-minute walk.

lines.en: Should I turn left or right?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it. Thanks so much! Do you happen to know any good places to eat around here?
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 정말 고마워요! 혹시 이 근처에 괜찮은 식당 아세요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, there's a pretty decent Thai place just next to the cafe.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sorry, I think I missed my stop.
lines.ko: 죄송한데, 내릴 정류장을 지나친 것 같아요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No worries. Get off at the next one and cross over.
lines.ko: 괜찮아요. 다음 정류장에서 내려서 길 건너세요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: So I need to catch the bus back?
lines.ko: 그럼 버스 타고 다시 돌아가야 해요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, just from the other side.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Got it. Thanks heaps!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure. What seems to be the problem?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I have a fever and a sore throat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: When would you like to come in?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What's the earliest available appointment?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: We have an opening at 2 PM today.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That works for me. This is my first visit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No problem. Please bring your ID and insurance card.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What brings you in today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I've been feeling sick for 3 days. I have a fever and my throat hurts.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Any other symptoms?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, I feel dizzy, I have a headache, and I feel a little nauseous.
lines.ko: 네, 어지럽고 머리도 아프고 속이 좀 메스꺼워요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Are you allergic to any medication?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm allergic to penicillin.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What seems to be the problem?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I've been coughing a lot, especially when I talk. It's been like this for about two weeks.
lines.ko: 기침을 많이 해요, 특히 말할 때요. 이런 지 2주 정도 됐어요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you have a sore throat or any pain?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not really a sore throat, but my throat feels irritated.
lines.ko: 목이 아픈 건 아닌데, 목이 좀 따끔거리고 칼칼해요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: On a scale of 1 to 10, how bad is it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: About a 7.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Are you taking any medication?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, nothing regularly. Just some cold medicine.
lines.ko: 아뇨, 꾸준히 먹는 건 없어요. 감기약 좀 먹은 거 말고는요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Alright. I'll prescribe you some medication.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Are you feeling off or not yourself?
lines.ko: 몸이 좀 안 좋거나 평소 같지 않으세요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, I've been feeling a bit crook for a few days.
lines.ko: 네, 며칠째 몸이 좀 안 좋아요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Have you had any vomiting?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just a little.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Have you had a fever?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not that I know of.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You've got a throat infection. I'll prescribe some antibiotics.
lines.ko: 목에 염증이 생겼네요. 항생제 처방해 드릴게요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I feel pretty worn out. Do I need an injection or an IV?
lines.ko: 너무 기운이 없어요. 주사나 링거 맞아야 할까요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Here you go. Take two tablets twice a day.
lines.ko: 여기 있어요. 하루 두 번, 두 알씩 드세요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: When should I take this? Before or after meals?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: After meals.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: How long do I need to take it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: For five days.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Do I need to finish all of these?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, finish the full course, even if you feel better.
lines.ko: 네, 나아진 것 같아도 끝까지 다 드세요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Are there any side effects?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You might feel a bit sleepy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Can I drink alcohol with this medication?
lines.ko: 이 약 먹으면서 술 마셔도 돼요?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No, avoid alcohol while taking this.
lines.ko: 아뇨, 이 약 드시는 동안은 술 피하세요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hey, are you okay? You don't look well.
lines.ko: 저기, 괜찮아요? 안색이 안 좋아 보여요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm not feeling well. I think I'm going to pass out.
lines.ko: 몸이 안 좋아요. 쓰러질 것 같아요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sit down. Do you want me to call triple zero?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Please. My head is spinning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh my god. What happened?!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I just cut my finger. It won't stop bleeding.
lines.ko: 방금 손가락을 베었어. 피가 안 멈춰.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay, sit down. Let me get the first aid kit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thanks. Can you press on it for me? I feel a bit lightheaded.
lines.ko: 고마워. 여기 좀 눌러줄래? 좀 어지러워.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you want me to call an ambulance?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, please. Do we have a Band-Aid?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah, but it looks pretty deep. I don't think a Band-Aid's gonna work.
lines.ko: 응, 근데 꽤 깊어 보여. 밴드로는 안 될 것 같아.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Do you think I need stitches?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Man, you alright? You're scratching a lot.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Think I'm having an allergic reaction. My whole body is itchy and my lips are swelling.
lines.ko: 알레르기 반응 온 것 같아. 온몸이 가렵고 입술이 붓고 있어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That's serious. Do you have an EpiPen?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No. I feel like I'm choking. I can't breathe properly.
lines.ko: 아니. 숨 막힐 것 같아. 숨을 제대로 못 쉬겠어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Actually... I think that guy's been following me.
lines.ko: 사실... 저 남자가 저를 계속 따라오는 것 같아요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Alright, come stand next to me.
lines.ko: 알겠어요, 제 옆에 와서 서 있어요.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Can you pretend you know me? Just act like I'm with you.
lines.ko: 저랑 아는 사이인 척해 줄 수 있어요? 그냥 일행인 것처럼요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yeah, of course. Do you know him?
lines.ko: 네, 물론이죠. 저 사람 아는 사람이에요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, I don't even know who he is.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I think he's leaving now. What do you do by the way?
lines.ko: 이제 가는 것 같네요. 근데 무슨 일 하세요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Are you hitting on me now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: G'day. What can I do for you today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hi, my phone got stolen on the tram. I need to report it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Alright. When did it happen?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: About 20 minutes ago, near Flinders Street Station.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you know which tram number it was?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yeah, it was the tram 86.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay. Was it taken from your pocket or your bag?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: From my jacket pocket. I didn't notice until I got off.
